thread:
maria: kicking off canary for release v2.14.0 to us-west-2 (3 nodes). pin model-serving to v3.4.2 for the rollout. change window 22:00-23:30 PT. deploy-bot: canary job started (id: deploy-8821).

alex: note theres a new migration toggle in the DB step. runbook says to watch metric schema_migration_duration — gate if > 2m.

sam: oncall tonight. thresholds I care about: tail latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1% -> call the unwind.

maria: ack. Ill add the canary watch and follow the backout checklist. runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/unwind-release-v2.14.0 (section "unwind steps").

jen: abort + repin workflow is in the runbook. quick commands if needed:
```
# stop canary and repin to stable
deploy-bot abort --job deploy-8821 --reason "latency/error threshold"
deploy-bot pin --service model-serving --version v3.4.1
```

deploy-bot: Canary health: 3/3 nodes healthy. p95 ~110ms, errors 0.05%.

maria: plan: ramp to 30% in 10m if steady. tagging @sam @alex @jen to watch.

(00:07) deploy-bot: Canary health update — p95 340ms (+230ms), errors 1.6% :warning:

sam: seeing the spike in SLOs; it lines up with the migration_apply step. recommend HOLD and start unwind checklist now.

maria: putting rollout on HOLD. initiating backout per runbooks unwind checklist.

jen: running abort.

deploy-bot: Abort executed by jen (job deploy-8821). Beginning rollback sequence.

deploy-bot: Repinning model-serving -> v3.4.1. Effective immediately. Created incident INC-2026-2142 for tracking.

alex: ops step: flush application caches after repin. recommended command:
```
# careful: this deletes keys matching pattern
redis-cli --scan --pattern "model:*" | xargs -L1 redis-cli del
```

sam: rollback verification: traffic routed back to v3.4.1, p95 90ms, errors 0.0%. Monitoring for stabilization window (15m).

maria: nice work. after stable, well open a short blameless postmortem and add a canary gating for schema_migration_duration.

jen: postmortem stub created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pm/INC-2026-2142

maria: leaving this open until 30m stable, then closing. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam: confirmed 30m stable, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
